name: Yuukyou Gangu
source:
Main character works at a company, but secretly has dreams of girls trained as dogs. One day he goes to catch women and realize his dream.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家公司任职，暗地里却一直梦想着把少女调教成狗。一天，他决定亲自抓来女人，让梦想化为现实。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
